message.content:
A medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal** (about 93 kJ).  
If you’re looking at a smaller cherry tomato, it’s about 5 kcal each, while a large heirloom tomato can be closer to 30–35 kcal.  

So, for most everyday cooking and snacking, you can round to about **20–25 kcal per medium tomato**.
